annotation.title_clean: Opinion of the European Economic and Social Committee on the Proposal for a Regulation amending Regulations (EU) 2021/694, 2021/695, 2021/697, 2021/1153, 2023/1525 and 2024/795 as regards incentivising defence-related investments in the EU budget to implement the ReArm Europe Plan
annotation.title_en: Opinion of the European Economic and Social Committee on the Proposal for a Regulation amending Regulations (EU) 2021/694, 2021/695, 2021/697, 2021/1153, 2023/1525 and 2024/795 as regards incentivising defence-related investments in the EU budget to implement the ReArm Europe Plan
annotation.venue: Official Journal of the European Union (C series)
annotation.summary_en: EESC opinion on the Commission proposal to redirect EU budget instruments toward defence investment under the ReArm Europe Plan. It endorses the aim but proposes amendments: a 50% cap on cohesion fund transfers, monitoring-committee approval, dual-use emphasis, social conditionalities, and an EU defence coordination body. AI Factories are mentioned only in passing.
key_provisions_or_claims: Endorses the proposal's aim of boosting defence investment via EU budget instruments, but recommends greater ambition.
Caps transfers from shared-management funds at 50% and requires national monitoring committee approval.
Specifies dual-use purposes in STEP and other programmes.
Calls for skills strategy and social conditionalities, with impact assessment for projects over EUR 25 million.
Calls for a dedicated EU body to coordinate defence purchasing and monitor dependencies, including kill-switch control.
